title: Clean Up Before Release
description: Release preparation is underway. Preserve the active login-fix work while cleaning up a stale branch that has already been merged into main.
objective: Rename the active login-fix branch without losing its work, then remove the already-merged signup branch.
whatToDo: Give the active login-fix branch a clearer name.
Make sure both login-fix commits remain intact after the rename.
Remove the old signup branch that has already been merged.
Leave main unchanged and finish with a clean repository.
hints: There are two kinds of branches here: active work that must be preserved, and old work that has already been merged. First identify which branch contains the unfinished login fixes and give it a clearer name.
After renaming the active branch, inspect its history. The two login-fix commits should still be attached to the renamed branch — renaming a branch should not change the commits it points to.
The signup feature was already merged into main before you started. Once you are on main, remove only the old signup branch. Leave the active login-fix branch intact.

intro.message: We're preparing the next release and the branch names are getting messy. The active login fix needs a clearer name, but don't disturb its two commits. The old signup work is already in main, so that stale branch can finally go.

success.message: Much cleaner. The active login fix is still completely intact, and the stale signup branch is out of the way. We're ready for the release.

failure.message: Something went wrong with the cleanup. The active login work must remain intact, while only the already-merged signup branch should be removed.
